P-05.title: Find the Falling Pressure
hints: Close GARDEN, clamp its feedthrough, reopen and verify five steady readings.
P-05.mastery: Six candidates within a two-per-phase limit, safe garden isolation and five steady 100/100/100 readings.

first_time_card.title: Find the falling pressure
first_time_card.purpose: Test the panel warning with an independent gauge before any valve move.
steps: Read MAIN, GARDEN and RETURN at t0 and t10.
Inspect six candidates with at most two in each investigation phase.
Verify annex isolation, close GARDEN only and check the repaired line five times.

EX-CH03-S01.title: The Warning and the Gauge
EX-CH03-S01.goal: Use an independent gauge before isolating any air line.
EX-CH03-S01.why: The electronic panel names a tank, but its diagnosis is unverified.

clues.text: Electronic panel warns of a tank fault; the manual gauge is independent.
A colour on a panel is not a pipe diagnosis.

EX-CH03-S01.aha: Use an independent gauge before isolating any air line.
EX-CH03-S01.wrong_idea: Close the red main reserve valve on the panel warning alone.
flight_rules: FR-02 ? Protect the main air reserve; verify with an independent gauge.

risk.title: Crew air cut by an unverified diagnosis

EX-CH03-S02.title: Six Places, Three Taps
EX-CH03-S02.goal: Find the falling branch with t0 and t10 readings; inspect two candidates each in phases one to three, then repair in phase four.
EX-CH03-S02.why: Only the garden branch falls over the ten-second manual comparison.

clues.text: A shaken garden feedthrough collar is downstream of the garden branch valve.

EX-CH03-S02.aha: Find the falling branch with t0 and t10 readings; inspect at most two candidates in each phase.
EX-CH03-S02.wrong_idea: Treat a noisy warning as proof that the main tank leaks.
flight_rules: FR-02 ? Inspect at most two locations per phase; keep crew air on.

risk.title: Missed leak or unnecessary trunk isolation

EX-CH03-S03.title: The Smallest Safe Boundary
EX-CH03-S03.goal: Verify annex auto-isolation, compare boundaries, and agree on rollback.
EX-CH03-S03.why: The aftershock changes the annex indicator; the garden leak remains the supported fault.

clues.text: The annex branch auto-isolates after the phase-two aftershock.
Keep the habitat supplied; isolate the smallest supported boundary.

EX-CH03-S03.aha: Verify annex auto-isolation, compare boundaries, and agree on rollback.
EX-CH03-S03.wrong_idea: Isolate the habitat trunk to stop both the leak and crew air.
flight_rules: FR-02 ? Keep protected crew air online and verify rollback before isolation.

EX-CH03-S04.title: Controlled Garden Repair
EX-CH03-S04.goal: Close GARDEN only, verify the hold, clamp from the safe side and log five steady checks.
EX-CH03-S04.why: A clamp seated is not a verified repair.

clues.text: After isolation MAIN holds 100 and GARDEN holds 74.
Seat the clamp and then reopen slowly.

EX-CH03-S04.aha: Close GARDEN only, verify the hold, clamp from the safe side and log five steady checks.
EX-CH03-S04.wrong_idea: Clamp the pressurised collar or reopen it fast.
flight_rules: FR-02 ? Verify hold before clamp and five steady checks two seconds apart.

risk.title: Pressure surge at a fresh clamp

EX-CH03-S05.title: The Wrong Note
EX-CH03-S05.goal: Correct a copied paper note to match five physical checks.
EX-CH03-S05.why: The tested valve setting is supported; the copied note is wrong.
new_hints: Which record was tested: the note or the valve?
Keep the tested state; correct the paper.
Strike the copied value, write the verified valve position, sign and date it.

clues.text: Five consecutive 100/100/100 mechanical checks are saved.
Correct the note, not the tested valve.

EX-CH03-S05.aha: Correct a copied paper note to match five physical checks.
EX-CH03-S05.wrong_idea: Change a tested valve to match an unverified paper note.
flight_rules: FR-02 ? Keep verified valve position and preserve the monitoring record.

risk.title: New leak introduced by clerical correction

EX-CH03-S06.title: The N.R. Hatch
EX-CH03-S06.goal: Isolate the annex feed, confirm zero differential and look by camera.
EX-CH03-S06.why: An isolated hatch can be inspected without authorising entry.
new_hints: Is seeing a room the same as being allowed in?
Isolate the feed and check the boundary before the port opens.
Feed OFF, boundary reading stable, open port, camera only, save view, close port.

clues.text: The annex door bears N.R.; the feed is isolated for boundary checks.
Use a camera before suited entry.

EX-CH03-S06.aha: Isolate the annex feed, confirm zero differential and look by camera.
EX-CH03-S06.wrong_idea: Open the hatch before measuring the pressure differential.
flight_rules: FR-02 ? Confirm zero differential before camera inspection; entry remains uncleared.
